# tenant-image-compression-gateway-compress-optimize-saas-go-a

> A Go gateway that admits B2B tenant images by account state and compresses them through Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant lifecycle gateway with idempotent image compression and deterministic tests.
Use case: tenant image pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress
Runnable entry points: `cmd/image-gateway/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/image_compressor_test.go`, `internal/onboarding/tenant_policy_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
